name: Distinguish a request for a turn from a claim about the wheel

uses.action: Run the charter that admitted requests for the spare pot against two accounts of a damaged wheel. What qualified as a request for a turn does not by itself establish what damaged the boards.

name: Try the limits of knowing as seeing

uses.action: Turn the sight-rooted word plate. Walk the wheel listener through the flat slot and through a late speaking window. Find out what is lost when the clerk can file a visible mark but the worker has heard a rhythm.

name: Notice who can enter a public record

uses.action: Walk the kitchen and the late porter under a spoken, tally or proxy rule. Choose where the claim can enter and when the clerk opens the book. A missing entry can hide a missed shift.
